source_issue.title: CI topology: PR #56 spawns a classifier storm on unrelated coordination/docs commits
source_issue.durable_law: Reuse the proven retirement pattern: keep automatic routing only for current authorities; preserve completed historical research as manual replay instead of permanent PR tax.

decision: No current aligned topology-cleanup branch owns the released-main debt.
Do not bulk-add concurrency comments/classifiers to 165 workflows.
Classify each v0.30 automatic workflow as current v0.31 authority, reusable current diagnostic, or durable historical one-shot.
Current/reusable automatic workflows must satisfy current CI architecture; historical one-shots should prefer workflow_dispatch-only retirement where repository doctrine permits.
Handle the three non-v0.30 failures separately because they are not covered by a blanket historical-v0.30 retirement argument.
